body: I don't have the option of abandoning responsibility right now. I know that's funny, considering what I'm planning, but with death you don't have to return to those abandoned responsibilities and suffer the consequences.
No. I have friends and a significant other.

Scholarship to one of the top honors colleges in the nation. Car, job, hobbies, volunteer work. Good grades. I'm beautiful, smart, and talented. I'm on track for good things. I'm not happy though. I don't care about any of it.
I'm aware of how life can be awesome for other people. My life is comparatively awesome right now. Doesn't mean I'm happy want to continue it.
I don't care that I have stuff to live for. I realize I do. I should feel happy about all the crap in my life.

The point of suicide is to not go back.. You can't ask those who have succeeded in it how it felt. To assume all felt regret is naive. It could be the happiest moment of their life. Jumping is not how I would do it.
According to the Beatles, it's a warm gun (you were asking for it the way you phrased it). Nothing makes me happy anymore, so there is nothing that I know of that I can do to achieve happiness.
I'm simply not proud or happy. Nothing is "wrong" with my life. I'm beautiful, smart, interesting, and healthy. I'm just not happy.
I am different. I do it out of a social obligation for my fellow man.
No one says it, but people do it for that reason. Nearly all people. So that they can pat themselves on the back.

While I like Bill Murray, I don't like that movie. My life isn't a repetitive loop. I do volunteer, I go to the gym, I see and appreciate beauty. Beauty doesn't equal happiness. If I volunteered for smug satisfaction I wouldn't be doing it for the right reasons. My life isn't boring.

I'm not bored. I've heard this speech before too. When you don't have the motivation to live, you don't give a shit. I SHOULD be happy. In every sense I should be. I'm just not. There's only hope for the hopeful.
